shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the left-hand mark at (−3,0) on the left with the mark at −2 on the number line on the right. Where two raised traces are shown, consider values satisfying both constraints.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The point belongs to the plotted graph and gives f(−3)=0. Right image: The filled dot admits −2 for its own bound, but the other constraint rejects that value.
Rationales: On the left, the filled marker adds that coordinate pair to the graph and supplies the value at its horizontal coordinate. On the right, although the selected dot is filled, the other marked ray does not reach −2. The value is outside the intersection.
